description: Upload or remove a project image. At most 5 images, 500 KB each, png, jpeg, or webp. Bytes are stored by LobsterMatch and served from this origin. Metadata is stripped. Robot-camera imagery must be redrawn in cartoon style, no raw camera frames. A published page does not show a new image until the page is approved again. One project write when the set changes, plus one object write for a new image.

action.description: upload or remove. upload is the default.

alt.description: What the image shows. Required when uploading.

data.description: Base64 image bytes. Required when uploading. At most 500 KB after decoding.

name: upload_project_image
title: Upload a project image
